name: OpenBot
description: Open-source AI coworkers that each get a computer of their own: a browser, files and tools, with every action decided before it happens and recorded after. Bring any AG-UI agent.
one_liner: An open-source 'AI coworker' platform that runs on your own servers, where each assistant gets its own browser, files, and permissions, and every action is logged.
buyer: An IT or security lead at a mid-size regulated company who wants staff to get agentic AI help without sending company data through a third-party vendor's cloud.
business_use_cases: A finance or healthcare company deploys it internally so staff get agentic AI tooling while all data and actions stay on company infrastructure.
An IT consultancy stands it up for clients whose compliance team previously blocked adoption of hosted AI assistants.
A software company gives each support rep an AI coworker that can browse internal tools, with a full audit log of every action for review.

money_ideas.idea: Paid implementation and custom-agent-stack integration services for enterprise clients.
Managed hosting and support contract for companies who want it running without owning the infrastructure.

steal_this: Offer a flat-fee 'OpenBot in a weekend' deployment for one department of a mid-size company, like support, then sell a monthly support retainer on top.
